svg.title: How a decision travels
svg.desc: An AI agent calls an MCP tool, payments:refund. The Straza server holds the call because it needs a person. A push notification carries only an opaque request id to the phone. The phone fetches the request over TLS pinned to the enrolled server before it shows anything, and the person decides behind a biometric prompt. The phone returns a decision signed with an ECDSA P-256 key held in secure hardware, valid once. The server verifies it and the call runs, or is denied. If nobody answers, the call is denied at timeout.
